## d7068a5d39a2

**Findings-only audit. Reproduced canonical support defect (D7068-C1), with a diagnostic shortcut; reproduced advertised-control defect (D7068-C2).** The target generator, Racket rule, and shared files were not changed.

### D7068-C1 — Per-input teaching requirements exclude canonical examples

The generator reserves a left-only, right-only, and overlapping coordinate in every ordinary input, then preserves those categories while adding a zero-output witness. Its validator rejects an input missing any category. This excludes **2 of the 5 canonical training inputs**: disjoint supports with background, and left support wholly contained in right support. Across all canonical pairs, **5/7 passed the target validator and 2/7 were rejected**.

| Canonical pair, zero-based | Left-only | Right-only | Overlap | Zero | Target validator result |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| `train[2]` | 2 | 3 | 0 | 4 | `no overlapping support cell; AND branch is never visible` |
| `train[4]` | 0 | 1 | 3 | 5 | `no left-only support cell; OR collapses toward right/AND` |

Both witnesses are rectangular ARC grids, satisfy the written nonzero-union rule and listed generator invariants, and are explicitly canonical. The supported Racket apply command returned **2/2 valid outputs matching the saved canonical answers exactly**. The restriction is therefore in generator support and validation; no incorrect Racket label was observed. The special `disjoint_halves` texture does not recover `train[2]`: it fills exactly one side of every coordinate and has no zero-output positions.

The retained intentional diagnostic rivals apply OR only if the input has an overlap (`train[2]` witness) or a left-exclusive coordinate (`train[4]` witness), returning zeros otherwise. Their outputs differ from Racket at **5 and 4 cells**, respectively. The overlap-gated rival agrees with the written OR formula on **60/60 sampled ordinary inputs**, covering seed `0`, sample indices `0..19` separately for easy, medium, and hard, with no overrides (**56 unique inputs**). All 60 inputs passed `self_check`. Only the two canonical counterexamples received separate Racket execution in this audit; the 60-draw comparison used the written formula.

**Shortcut status: diagnostic suspicion only.** These rivals do not fit every canonical pair and are not measured learner errors or a demonstrated ambiguous production lesson. They expose behavior that the generated examples never require. The concrete defect is exclusion of canonical input regimes. A task-local remedy would admit those regimes while requiring sufficient OR-discriminating evidence across a complete demonstration set, then verify lesson assembly separately.

### D7068-C2 — Advertised valid controls fail before generation

At seed `0`, sample index `0`, difficulty `None`, **3/3 retained control probes raised `ValueError`** despite lying in the declared `AXES` ranges:

| Overrides | Advertised range | Actual exception |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `grid_h=1` | `1..30` | Override 1 outside `[3, 5]` |
| `half_w=1` | `1..15` | Override 1 outside `[3, 4]` |
| `grid_h=3, half_w=3, or_target=9` | `or_target: 1..h*half_w` | Override 9 outside `[1, 3]` |

The implementation uses default sampling bounds as override validation bounds. The `or_target` default expression is evaluated even when the override is supplied. These probes produced no grids, so output validation is inapplicable. Either support the advertised controls or declare the actual ranges and incompatibilities. All exceptions are retained in the probe report.

### Source identity, reproduction, and limits

- Generator version: `1.6.0`; SHA-256: `bfd9ddbf132d3483d050d6a80bde6dee724299d7fdba845e350d4f08009ad521`.
- Executed/catalog Racket rule hash: `af8f4a541fe1`, matching; executed rule text SHA-256: `c5d3dca063ed9fed7e38111666373189808e38d0c953b78524cde00c2b439481`.
- [Complete source-bound evidence](checks/audit/d7068a5d39a2/evidence.json) contains both inputs, actual and rival outputs, validation/domain status, source identities, and exact commands. The raw canonical program string hash is recorded separately from the apply tool's executed-text hash.
- [Probe and retained exceptions](checks/audit/d7068a5d39a2/probe.json), [reproducer](checks/audit/d7068a5d39a2/probe.py), [Racket authority record](checks/audit/d7068a5d39a2/racket.json), and [command records](checks/audit/d7068a5d39a2/commands.json) are included.
- The probe and authority commands both exited `0`. The commands ran from `packet_root` through `run_with_racket.py`; their payload cwd was `repo`, as recorded. Audit inputs were canonical, so seed/sample/overrides are null for the two Racket witnesses.
- No full battery, production lesson census, private runner import, or solve/private-answer inspection was performed. The audit does not establish universal correctness or induction.
